label: Asymptotic closure
title: A long tail of cheap predictive repairs is not Class-IV-specific
summary: On the frozen width-10 block-parity test, Rule 30 has a much longer thin tail of minimal predictive repairs than Rules 54/110. Its stable quotient is almost microscopic identity, so tail length alone fails to identify the hoped-for complex regime.
takeaway: Repeated cheap repair can mean compression is collapsing toward the full microstate. The asymptote needs at least a second coordinate describing how much compression survives.
